Start official Claude Code CLI sign-in

AndCode starts the official Claude Code CLI inside the Linux environment on this device.

Authentication and communication with Anthropic (or your configured provider) are handled entirely by the official Claude Code CLI.

AndCode passes the sign-in URL and the code you enter through to the local CLI process. It does not copy the resulting OAuth token into Android settings, send it to an AndCode server, or reuse it for any other tool.

You need your own usable account or provider configuration. Anthropic's current terms of service and plan conditions apply.

AndCode starts the official, unmodified Google Antigravity CLI inside the Linux environment on this device.

Authentication, model access, and communication with Google are handled entirely by the official Antigravity CLI.

AndCode does not extract, store, or transmit Google OAuth tokens, and does not reuse them for other agents such as OpenCode or Claude Code.

You need your own usable Google account. Google Antigravity's current terms of service, offering terms, and usage limits apply.
This changes what the CLI can do

Turning this on lets the official CLI change files or run commands without asking you first.\n\nPRoot is a compatibility runtime, not a full security sandbox. Back up anything important, and only use trusted repositories, prompts, and MCP servers.
Allow access to all device files?
